{{recipesummary|category=Meat recipes| Yield = 1 loaf|servings=12 servings|time=60 minutes|difficulty=3| Energy = 88 Cal}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Meat and Poultry|Meat and Poultry]] | [[Cookbook:Bison|Bison]]

'''Bison loaf''' is a [[Cookbook:Meatloaf|meat loaf]] made from bison instead of [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]].

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] (900 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) ground [[Cookbook:Bison|bison]] meat
*1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] soft [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|bread crumbs]] (from about 2 slices of bread) or ½ cup fine dry bread crumbs
*1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
*½ cup 1% [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*½ medium [[Cookbook:Green Pepper|green pepper]], chopped
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire sauce]] (optional)
*1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Garlic powder|garlic powder]]
*½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]

==Procedure==
# In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together.
# Form meat mixture into a loaf or pat into a lightly-oiled [[Cookbook:Loaf Pan|loaf pan]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a 300°F (150°C) [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] for 45 minutes until internal temperature reaches 160°F (72°C).
